full_details: The loaf was two fingers short, and still a penny. Morning prayer at St Helen's ended with the sand, and the close was still visible from the south porch. Sir John Spencer was in his pew, and he did not speak to you. You went home. By three the fog off the river had taken the porch from the window. You lit two candles. Mistress Ansell saw them from the stair and said the sixpence is the firing, and that she would not give you a third. Alse shut the street door. Gib slept on the Chaucer. You wrote the fairy king's bank, the thyme off the brook above Shottery, the oxlips from the lane to Wilmcote, the violets anybody's. It came almost too sweetly. You left the lines unstruck, and you did not trust them. You did not go out again.
one_sentence: After church a yellow fog took the porch, and at three you wrote a bank of wild thyme and left the lines standing.
title: Wrote a bank of wild thyme in the yellow fog
